statement:
∀ {ι : Type ?u.2} (s : Finset ι) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    ∀ (w c : ι → ℂ) (k : ι → ℕ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, w i ∈ ball 0 ρ) →
        ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall 0 ρ) →
            (∑ i ∈ s, if k i = 0 then c i else 0) + -residue (fun z => ∑ i ∈ s, c i / (z - w i) ^ (k i + 1) + g z) 0 ρ =
              0
